title: Reconcile equipment billings by region with vendor revenue by region and fiscal calendars (SEMI WWSEMS vs AMAT, Lam, TEL, KLA, ASML, Advantest)
why_it_matters: China was 36.5% of 2025 SEMI billings but 30% of AMAT FY2025 and 42% of TEL FY2025 revenue; differing fiscal years, ship-to vs install location and service revenue make cross-source comparisons error-prone.
questions: How does each vendor attribute revenue to regions (ship-to, install site, customer HQ)?
How much of the gap between SEMI China billings and vendor China revenue is service vs new tools?
Can vendor revenue be calendarised to compare with WWSEMS?

title: Back-end equipment segment detail: assembly & packaging tools (dicing, bonding, hybrid bonding, molding) and probers/handlers, vendors and shares
why_it_matters: Test and A&P were ~13% of 2025 equipment and the fastest-growing segments (+55% / +21%); vendor shares exist publicly for testers (Advantest) and probers (TEL) but not for A&P tools.
questions: Who leads dicing (Disco), die/hybrid bonding (BESI, ASMPT, Hanmi), molding and wafer bonding (EVG, TEL)?
What share do probers and handlers take of test equipment spend?
